ไม่ได้อยู่ในเขตอำนาจศาลที่ถูกคว่ำบาตรหรืออยู่ในรายชื่อคว่ำบาตรใด ๆ;

One Seeker, one voice
Undersigned is a review layer beside the dApp Store. Only wallets holding a Seeker Genesis Token are counted, so one device is one voice. Nothing to buy, stake or earn.
Signed, not typed
Every review is a small transaction you approve on the phone with the double-tap. Your wallet pays only the network fee it sets. Undersigned never holds your keys or funds.
Beside the store, not instead of it
The store\'s own rating and reviews are shown next to the signed ones, credited. Installs open in the store. You can bring your existing store reviews across with one signature.
What your phone can prove
For apps you have installed, Undersigned shows whether the build matches the certificate the store lists and whether permissions changed. Facts, never verdicts.
Follow, get told, reply
Follow apps to hear about new signed reviews, updates and replies. Publishers claim their app by signing and answer with a verified badge. Everything you publish is permanent and public.
Also post in the dApp Store
Copies your note and opens the listing in the store. The store has no way for another app to post for you, so the last taps are yours.
